title: Owner: present decisions with what is relevant in their context; incompatible answers serving different remedies are gold for the research (2026-11-05)

sections.name: owner-words
sections.label: Owner's words (verbatim)
sections.content:
I've accepted 998 for now. 
But this suggested decision information is far more valuable for review. 
These are important elements for how we present decisions - with information that is relevant in the context of the decision. 

We can still require some serious technical decision when they are needed. But these should also be very speccific about what teh technical context is. 

These strategic decisions are also going to be relevant to the problems and remedies that we have identified. 

It will be very interesting to find when we have two different and incompatible answers that serve different remedies. That's probably  gold for our reseach into decisions.
